name: chatconnect
description: ChatConnect — real-time MERN chat app (web, desktop via Electron, mobile via Capacitor)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:frontend && npm run --prefix desktop dev
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:frontend && npm run --prefix desktop build
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:frontend && npx cap sync
